skill.description: Automates Sentry workflows through Rube MCP, including issue triage, alert rules, releases, monitors, projects, teams, and organization lookups.

static_findings.snippet: - Active Sentry connection via `RUBE_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS` with toolkit `sentry`
- Always call `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` first to get current tool schemas
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
1. Verify Rube MCP is available by confirming `RUBE_SEARCH_TOOLS` responds
2. `SENTRY_GET_ORGANIZATION_ISSUE_DETAILS` - Get detailed info on a specific issue [Optional]
3. `SENTRY_LIST_AN_ISSUES_EVENTS` - View individual error events for an issue [Optional]
4. `SENTRY_RETRIEVE_AN_ISSUE_EVENT` - Get full event details with stack trace [Optional]
5. `SENTRY_RETRIEVE_ISSUE_TAG_DETAILS` - Inspect tag distribution for an issue [Optional]
- `organization_id_or_slug` is the org slug (e.g., 'my-org'), not the display name
- Query syntax uses Sentry's search format: `is:unresolved`, `assigned:me`, `!has:release`
1. `SENTRY_RETRIEVE_ORGANIZATION_PROJECTS` - List projects to find project slug [Prerequisite]
2. `SENTRY_RETRIEVE_PROJECT_ISSUES_LIST` - List issues for a specific project [Required]
3. `SENTRY_RETRIEVE_ISSUE_EVENTS_BY_ID` - Get events for a specific issue [Optional]
- `actions`: Array of actions to perform when triggered
- `frequency` is in minutes; setting too low causes alert fatigue
- `actionMatch` defaults may vary; explicitly set to avoid unexpected behavior
4. `SENTRY_CREATE_RELEASE_DEPLOY_FOR_ORG` - Record a deployment for a release [Optional]
- `projects`: Array of project slugs this release belongs to
- Releases can span multiple projects; use the `projects` array
- `cursor`: Pagination cursor for large result sets
- `checkin_margin`: Grace period in minutes for late check-ins
- Sentry uses cursor-based pagination with `Link` headers
**Get Rube MCP**: Add `https://rube.app/mcp` as an MCP server in your client configuration. No API k
- Conditions, actions, and filters use specific JSON schemas; check Sentry docs for valid types
- `actionMatch` defaults may vary; explicitly set to avoid unexpected behavior
| Get issue details | SENTRY_GET_ORGANIZATION_ISSUE_DETAILS | organization_id_or_slug, issue_id |
| Get event details | SENTRY_RETRIEVE_AN_ISSUE_EVENT | organization_id_or_slug, event_id |

content.value_statement: Sentry operations often require many API calls across issues, alerts, releases, monitors, and teams. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through Rube MCP workflows.
actual_capabilities: Lists and inspects Sentry organization issues, project issues, events, tags, and stack traces.
Creates and updates project alert rules and organization metric alerts through Rube MCP tools.
Creates releases, updates release metadata, records deploys, and uploads release files.
Lists organizations, teams, members, and projects available to the authenticated Sentry user.
Updates Sentry cron monitor configuration with schedule, margin, and runtime settings.
Documents required ID formats, pagination handling, search query syntax, permissions, and rate limits.
limitations: Requires Rube MCP and an active Sentry OAuth connection before any workflow can run.
Depends on the authenticated user's Sentry permissions and visible organizations.
Does not include executable automation code or direct Sentry API clients.
Tool schemas may change, so users must search current Rube tool definitions first.

use_cases.title: Triage Production Errors
use_cases.description: On-call engineers can list unresolved issues, inspect events, and review tag patterns before assigning work.

use_cases.title: Maintain Alert Coverage
use_cases.description: DevOps teams can review existing alert rules and create project or organization alerts with explicit conditions.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Releases
use_cases.description: Release managers can create Sentry releases, record deploys, and connect versions to production environments.

prompt_templates.title: List My Open Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Use the Sentry automation skill to find unresolved issues in organization <org-slug>. Search Rube tools first, then list priority items.

prompt_templates.title: Inspect One Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Investigate Sentry issue <issue-id> for organization <org-slug>. Retrieve details, recent events, stack traces, and tag patterns.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Project Alert
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Sentry project alert for <project-slug> in <org-slug>. Search current schemas, show the proposed rule, and ask before creating it.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Release Monitoring
prompt_templates.prompt: For release <version>, review existing releases, create missing release records, record deployment to <environment>, and verify related project coverage.

output_examples.input: List unresolved high-priority issues for the payments project.
output: Resolved the payments project slug from the organization project list.
Found unresolved issues sorted by priority, with event counts and last-seen times.
Highlighted items with repeated browser or release tags for faster triage.

output_examples.input: Create an alert when checkout errors spike in production.
output: Reviewed existing project rules to avoid duplicate alerts.
Prepared a proposed alert with production filters, trigger conditions, and notification actions.
Asked for approval before creating the rule in Sentry.
Checked existing releases for the requested version.
Created or updated release metadata for the selected projects.
Recorded the deployment environment and verified release visibility.

best_practices: Search Rube tool schemas before each workflow, because MCP tool parameters may change.
Confirm organization and project slugs before using mutating Sentry actions.
Ask for approval before creating alerts, releases, deploy records, uploads, or monitor updates.
anti_patterns: Do not assume display names are valid Sentry slugs.
Do not create low-frequency alerts without discussing alert fatigue.
Do not ignore cursor pagination when listing large issue, member, or release sets.

faq.question: Does this skill require a Sentry API token?
faq.answer: No direct API token is stored in the skill. It uses Rube MCP with an active Sentry OAuth connection.

faq.question: Can it change Sentry configuration?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide creation and updates for alerts, releases, deploys, uploads, and monitors when the user has permission.

faq.question: Why must it search tools first?
faq.answer: Rube MCP schemas can change. Searching first helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code call the current tool shape.

faq.question: Can it inspect stack traces?
faq.answer: Yes. It can retrieve issue events and event details when the Sentry connection permits access.

faq.question: Does it handle pagination?
faq.answer: The skill reminds users to follow cursor pagination until all required results are collected.

faq.question: Is this only for production projects?
faq.answer: No. It can work with any Sentry environment or project visible to the authenticated user.
